verdict.rationale: Riveter publishes an official Go SDK on GitHub with typed client examples (Enrich, Runs.List), and its docs say the SDKs handle auth, retries, the wait long-poll, wait_for_result polling, and pagination. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Go (the docs say 'SDKs' but only Go is named), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Go SDK for the Riveter API — enrich data, build datasets, scrape pages, and run web searches.
Prefer a typed client over raw HTTP — the SDKs handle auth, retries (429s and transient GET failures), the wait long-poll, polling until a run finishes (wait_for_result), and pagination
